description:
Classic twin top tube klunk frameset.

The twin top tube Monē has been avaiable only as a full custom, until now. Small batch frames brazed in Silver City, New Mexico out of the back of a bread truck. These limited frame and fork saves over $1000 from full custom and will be avaiable with little to no wait time…helping spread the good word of coaster brakes to those with an eye for the old school.

2 sizes fit most. S/M and L/XL. Slackish comfy GEO while staying playful… these are a hoot to ride.

Full Cro-Moly with butted seat and downtube. Don’t tell anyone but these are pretty dang lightweight. Skinny tubes have a classic look and ride so nice. The fork is a klunk specific design with skinnier blades than you’d ever find on a bike with a front disc brake. V supple. V nice. I can do a bi-plane with disc mount i

2 bottle bosses. Rear coaster arm mount and a rear iso disc mount for posterity. A clean “nothin you don’t” setup.

27.2 seatpost

A few finish options… I can send it raw, I would invite you to finish as you want. I also have a 2 part hardening rattle can clear coat with gun blue’d logos. Also offering a turbo midnight finish which frame will be brushed, gun blued w/ mask’d logos and clear powder coated. The turbo is the most robust of the three but nothing is perfect in the world of clear coats. The rattle can finish will develop some surface rust over time…if you live in a rusty climate or don’t like the look, go with the turbo or come. up with something yourself.

The frameset includes a laser cut Monē headbadge but can be upgraded to a brass-copper, handmade in Khatmandu, lightweight headbadge..This option also include coins brazed to the bottom of the fork blades.

I have 2 s/m and 2 l/xl ready to ship now. If you order and I’m out, plan on 6-8 weeks and I’ll get you rolling on the next batch.
